description: Foreign holdings of U.S. long-term securities by country and month, from U.S. Department of the Treasury's Treasury International Capital (TIC) System, Table 1: U.S. Long-Term Securities Held by Foreign Residents. Covers Treasury securities, agency bonds, corporate bonds and corporate equity, each with holdings, net U.S. purchases/sales and a valuation-change breakdown. Pass "country" for one country's recent history (e.g. "Japan", "China"); omit it for a ranking of the largest foreign holders of U.S. securities in a given month (default: most recently published). Monthly cadence, published with roughly a 6-week lag. Answers "how much does Japan hold in US securities", "who are the biggest foreign holders of US stocks and bonds", "has China been buying or selling US Treasuries".

country.description: Country name, e.g. "Japan", "China", "United Kingdom". Omit for a cross-country ranking.

limit.description: Ranking mode: how many countries to return (1-50, default 20). Country mode: how many recent months of history (1-60, default 12).

month.description: YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recently published month.

name: tic_foreign_holdings
title: Tic Foreign Holdings
